about.en: I'm Ray Tian, a first-year Honours Mathematics (Co-op) student at the University of Waterloo. I'm interested in data-driven problem solving, product development and technology-enabled business solutions. I like problems that start from something concrete: a bug I can reproduce, a tool classmates actually need, a group that needs organizing. Away from the keyboard I play table tennis and piano, follow open-source projects, and enjoy rhythm games and interactive digital experiences.
about.zh: 我是 Ray Tian，滑铁卢大学数学荣誉学士（Co-op）大一学生，关注数据驱动的问题解决、产品开发，以及由技术支撑的商业解决方案。我喜欢从具体问题出发：一个可以复现的 bug、同学真正需要的工具、一个需要有人组织的小组。离开键盘，我打乒乓球、弹钢琴，关注开源项目，也喜欢节奏游戏和互动式数字体验。

items.en: Coursework: MATH 135 Algebra, MATH 137 Calculus 1, ECON 101 Introductory Microeconomics. Learning: SQL and Python (introductory, not proficient). Practice: reproducible test cases, checking a fix against before-and-after results, time-zone and date handling (job-ops PR).
items.zh: 课程：MATH 135 代数、MATH 137 微积分 1、ECON 101 微观经济学入门。学习中：SQL 与 Python（入门，尚不熟练）。实践：可复现的测试用例、用修复前后结果核对修复、时区与日期处理（job-ops PR）。

items.en: Turning a real student need into a scoped tool (WatDesk); bilingual English and Simplified Chinese interface and copy; GitHub issues, pull requests and maintainer communication; CI checks in GitHub Actions; organizing study groups and a peer listening group.
items.zh: 把真实的学生需求做成范围清晰的工具（WatDesk）；英文与简体中文双语界面和文案；GitHub issue、pull request 与维护者沟通；GitHub Actions 的 CI 检查；组织学习小组和同伴倾听小组。

items.en: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vite, Vitest, browser-extension APIs (Manifest V3), ASan/UBSan (used in Madeira PRs); AI coding assistants, used with review and testing as described above.

items.en: Project use: TypeScript, JavaScript, React (WatDesk). Coursework: Racket (CS 135). Limited exposure: C, Swift, Rust, Python (open-source pull requests and personal projects, with AI coding assistance). Introductory: SQL.
items.zh: 项目使用：TypeScript、JavaScript、React（WatDesk）。课程：Racket（CS 135）。有限接触：C、Swift、Rust、Python（开源 PR 与个人项目，借助 AI 编程助手）。入门：SQL。
